# Artifacts

The Artifacts category has 2 tasks. Each entry shows the task's latest revision, the one the palette adds. See [Reading an entry](./overview#reading-an-entry).

## Download Artifact

Download an artifact of this run, or the workflow's kept artifact of that name, into the run workspace, checking its SHA-256.

- **Slug:** `download-artifact`
- **Type:** `downloadartifact`
- **Revision:** 1
- **Image:** The image in the dispatcher's `flow.dispatcher.artifact.image` property, `boomerangio/task-flow:3.3.0` by default.

**Parameters**

| Label | Name | Type | Required | Default | Helper text |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Artifact name | `name` | Text | Yes |  | An artifact an earlier task in this run uploaded, or with scope workflow the workflow's kept artifact of that name. |
| Destination path | `path` | Text | Yes |  | Where to put it; an uploaded folder is unpacked here. Relative to /workspace (e.g. workflowrun/inputs/), or an absolute path. |
| Scope | `scope` | Select | No | `run` | run: this run only, expires on its retention date. workflow: kept for every later run of this workflow until replaced. |
| Optional | `optional` | Boolean | No | `false` | Succeed with result found=false when no artifact of this name exists, instead of failing. |
| Download link | `url` | Secured, read-only | No |  | Filled in by Flow when the task runs. |
| Download headers | `headers` | Text, read-only | No |  | Filled in by Flow when the task runs. |
| SHA-256 | `sha256` | Text, read-only | No |  | Filled in by Flow when the task runs. |
| Content type | `contentType` | Text, read-only | No |  | Filled in by Flow when the task runs. |

**Results**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `found` | true when an artifact was downloaded |

## Upload Artifact

Upload a file or folder from the run workspace as an artifact of this run or of the workflow.

- **Slug:** `upload-artifact`
- **Type:** `uploadartifact`
- **Revision:** 1
- **Image:** The image in the dispatcher's `flow.dispatcher.artifact.image` property, `boomerangio/task-flow:3.3.0` by default.

**Parameters**

| Label | Name | Type | Required | Default | Helper text |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Artifact name | `name` | Text | Yes |  | Unique within the run. Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore. |
| Path | `path` | Text | Yes |  | A file or folder to upload; a folder is sent as one .tar.gz. Relative to /workspace (e.g. workflowrun/reports/sbom.json), or an absolute path. |
| Scope | `scope` | Select | No | `run` | run: this run only, expires on its retention date. workflow: kept for every later run of this workflow until replaced. |
| Retention days | `retention-days` | Text | No |  | Blank keeps it for the workspace's retention. You can ask for fewer days, not more. Not allowed with scope workflow. |
| Upload link | `url` | Secured, read-only | No |  | Filled in by Flow when the task runs. |
| Upload headers | `headers` | Text, read-only | No |  | Filled in by Flow when the task runs. |

No results.
